services.desc: Biloxi inshore nearshore fishing trip. The Biloxi Bay is home to some of Mississippi’s finest inshore fishing. With this said, the Bay provides a very scenic view of the Mississippi Gulf Coast. Some things you may see are Bald Eagles and Osprey, definitely Brown Pelicans and Seagulls. Occasionally, you can spot Bottlenose Dolphin cruising by. The Biloxi Bay offers protected waters. What this means is if the wind is blowing normally the water in the bay can be calm. Biloxi bay is home for many different species such as Redfish, Speckled Trout, Flounder and more. We can catch these fish in the spring, summer and fall.
